name: pitchfork-recording
description: Automated silent demo recording: Playwright captures the live screen, Remotion composes title cards over the footage.

scripts.render: npx remotion render src/index.ts Demo out/pitchfork-demo.mp4 --crf 12
scripts.web: ffmpeg -y -i out/pitchfork-demo.mp4 -vf scale=1920:1200:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 20 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/pitchfork-demo-1080p.mp4
scripts.webm: npm run webm:pass1 && npm run webm:pass2
